annotations.title: Check an employer against the fair hiring badge

description: Job Spotter. Check an employer against the fair hiring badge. For "is this employer fair to applicants?". Four checks from what the employer does: shows pay in its adverts on Job Spotter, replies to tracked applications, hires through scored consent-first introductions, and (UK employers with 250 or more staff) reports its gender pay gap on time. Each check comes with its figures; the badge is earned when every check with data passes and at least two have data. Includes a badge image link.
name: jobspotter_fair_hiring_check
